presets.name: Safe / Default
presets.description: Translation only. Minimal changes and safest default for all devices.

presets.name: Balanced
presets.description: Translation plus conservative graphics config for common upper-mid and flagship devices.
presets.warning: Balanced changes graphics config but does not force Vulkan, resolution scale, FPS unlock, or high-end profile spoofing.

presets.name: Performance
presets.description: Translation plus lower-stutter config for mid-range and lower-end devices.

presets.name: Max Graphics
presets.description: Heavy visual config for high-end devices only.
presets.warning: Max Graphics may cause heat, battery drain, crashes, or FPS drops. Recommended only for high-end devices.
